items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you lived in a house that had belonged to Holly Woodlawn, the Warhol “superstar.”

ctx.x: I think I read, researching you on the Internet, you lived in a house that had belonged to Holly Woodlawn, the Warhol “superstar.”

Yes, we were subletting from her on 10th Street. I think that’s when she went to go have her... Oh, no, it must have been well after. But she was the one, wasn’t she, who had the sex change operation? The first?
